name: The Woman at the Well
title: The Samaritan Woman
summary: A Samaritan woman who met Jesus at Jacob's well in Sychar. Through her conversation with Jesus, she became the first person to whom he revealed himself as the Messiah, and she became an early evangelist who led many from her town to faith in Jesus.

keyEvents.title: The Meeting at Jacob's Well
keyEvents.description: Jesus asked the woman for water at the well, which was remarkable since Jews normally did not associate with Samaritans. This began a deep conversation about living water.

keyEvents.title: The Conversation About Living Water
keyEvents.description: Jesus told the woman about living water that gives eternal life and awakened her spiritual hunger.

keyEvents.title: Revelation of Her Past
keyEvents.description: Jesus showed prophetic knowledge of her five previous husbands and that she was now living with a man who was not her husband.

keyEvents.title: The Conversation About True Worship
keyEvents.description: Jesus taught the woman that true worship is not about place, but about worshipping the Father in spirit and truth.

keyEvents.title: Jesus Reveals Himself as the Messiah
keyEvents.description: When the woman mentioned the Messiah, Jesus declared directly: 'It is I, the one speaking to you.' This was the first time Jesus so clearly revealed his identity.

keyEvents.title: The Testimony in the Town
keyEvents.description: The woman left her water jar and went into the town to tell about Jesus. Her testimony led many Samaritans to believe.
